navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Oklahoma State University-Main Campus (campus setting: Town: Distant)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025). International (non-resident, by address at application) admit rate was only 305 of 1,655 (18%), far below the in-state 74% and out-of-state 79%, so do not assume an easy admit for international applicants who miss the 3.0 GPA + English 'assured admission' criteria. No waitlist; no early decision or early action. Undergrad enrollment is B1 total undergraduates (23,003); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident total (418). SAT composite 25/50/75 = 1060/1160/1250. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column (sums to 100.02).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (fall 2027): SAT/ACT use is marked as not required for admission; the CDS says students may apply 'without consideration of a test score' and be reviewed on their high school transcript.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (first-year, 2025-26): tuition is 30 credit hours at $180.55 resident / $697.90 nonresident per credit hour ($5,416.50 / $20,937.00); room and board is the on-campus food-and-housing figure. Transportation estimate $2,300 not included in other_usd. CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both available to nonresidents; 169 nonresident undergraduates received it (avg $10,492).
